ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Semiconductors extend rebound even as 10Y returns to about 5%
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: SOX rose 2.78%. NVIDIA gained 1.34%, AMD 2.70% and TSM ADR 1.02%, while Apple fell 0.26% and Microsoft 0.80%. The price structure still favors AI hardware despite higher discount rates.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Anthropic and Accenture commit $2B to independent AI model evaluation
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: The partnership expands third-party model evaluation and safety testing as frontier-AI governance concerns rise, showing safety spending is becoming a material enterprise AI category rather than an outright capex freeze.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: European AI firms push back against calls to slow model development
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Mistral and other European AI companies argued that broad slowdown proposals could entrench U.S. incumbents, reinforcing a policy split between safety restraint and competitive acceleration.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: SK Hynix Solidigm weighs a U.S. NAND fab
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported Solidigm is considering a U.S. NAND factory as policy pressure and AI/data-center storage demand reshape semiconductor supply chains.

breaking_news.headline: 10Y closes 4.995% after breaching 5% intraday; Fed hike expectations remain live
breaking_news.market_impact: Higher discount rates capped the broader market, but semiconductor strength kept the S&P 500 and Nasdaq positive.

breaking_news.headline: WTI falls to $100.30 as China urges Iran to limit Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure
breaking_news.market_impact: Energy inflation pressure eased at the margin, but oil remains above $100 and Middle East supply risk is unresolved.

breaking_news.headline: BOJ raises policy rate to 1.25%, a 31-year high
breaking_news.market_impact: The 7-2 vote and two dissents softened expectations for rapid follow-up hikes; the dollar strengthened against the yen.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. August industrial production flat; manufacturing output falls 0.3%
breaking_news.market_impact: Factory output missed expectations and ended a seven-month manufacturing expansion streak, offsetting some inflation pressure with a growth-slowdown signal.

breaking_news.headline: Volkswagen slashes 2026 profit-margin guidance
breaking_news.market_impact: VW flagged about €10B of one-offs, largely Porsche-related, and cut expected operating margin to at most 1% from 4.0%-5.5%.

earnings_summary.last_24h: No new U.S. mega-cap technology earnings were verified in the cutoff window. The largest fresh corporate guidance shock was Volkswagen: roughly €10B of one-offs and 2026 operating margin guidance cut to at most 1% from 4.0%-5.5%. Nucor and Steel Dynamics also issued Q3 EPS guidance below Wall Street estimates.
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: AI/semiconductor market pricing remains resilient, while autos, steel and housing provide clearer evidence that high rates, tariffs and input costs are pressuring cyclical margins.

narration_points: 市場風險焦點回到十年債殖利率約5%，但SOX連續反彈顯示AI硬體需求仍有韌性。
油價新聞仍是通膨關鍵：WTI回落到100.30美元，但仍守在百元上方。
AI新聞不是需求崩塌，而是安全治理支出上升與政策分歧；Anthropic與Accenture投入20億美元模型評估。
台股現貨大漲1.93%，外資買超約869.94億元；台指期外資淨空單降至76110口。
美國製造業8月產出下滑0.3%，為高利率與高成本環境提供成長降溫訊號。

台股大漲892.75點，外資大買，但週五夜盤最終值等待TAIFEX同session補齊。
